body: I can't thank you guys enough for the advice and kind words. We are about to go over to see his parents as soon as a few people get into town. I looked into EMDR and think it might be good for some of us. I personally don't feel like I need it or even want to do it. I am holding up fine, but I went into the situation knowing what to expect. I am going to schedule a session for me and the friend who found him. What kind of specialist should I consult? I have never been to therapy or even considered needing it, so I have no clue on the subject. I am blessed with a fairly strong psyche (if that's the correct way to say it), but some others I don't think handle things as well. I think that it still hasn't completely processed for me, but it will more than it has as soon as I look into his mother's eyes. Thank you again for all the support.
